oa_seconds_scope: OA flow total deadline; not model request timeout
release_steps: Read current Deployment image, generation/resourceVersion, pause state and environment references
Bind committed source to candidate image; pass installed-image QA and preload eligible nodes
Prepare one concurrency-guarded update containing the candidate gateway image and required environment entries
Resume a paused Deployment only as part of the operator-authorized release window
Verify desired replica convergence, candidate image and all required env values across gateway containers
Verify actual OA startup behavior and model performance logs through controlled acceptance
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not delete its existing execution marker or reuse its generation-404 verification plan
Do not interpret ready replicas alone as proof of 3600-second adoption
Do not change the image and environment in separate unpaused rollouts
